aka: Τα ρόδα, τα τριαντάφυλλα (Το μπλόκο της Καλαμαριάς)
this_title: Flowers and Roses (The Roundup of Kalamaria)
trans_title: Τα ρόδα, τα τριαντάφυλλα (Το μπλόκο της Καλαμαριάς)
introduction: On August 13, 1944, Greek Nazi collaborators invaded Kalamaria region, southeast of Thessaloniki,with a kill list. They had assassinated 11 people by noon. At that time, the mayor organized a celebration in their honor. The invaders got drunk and left Kalamaria singing “Flowers and Roses” without completing their list.
